title: Require full body consumption for complete PERSUBENTMGR prefix status
trigger: S42's source-bound AC1021 trace stopped at body bit 243 with a body bound of 205099, while the PERSUBENTMGR status path used bodyFits() alone to select Complete. bodyFits() proves the cursor remains within the limit; it does not prove the body was consumed. The status feeds the raw carrier's typedPayloadValidated disposition.

change.behavior: PERSUBENTMGR receives Complete only when bodyFits() is true, the decoded cursor equals bodyEndBit, and the profile is not one of the already bounded abbreviated-prefix cases. An unconsumed tail remains Partial and therefore follows the existing raw/unvalidated carrier route.
change.scope: Status and raw-validation classification only. No field order, vector meaning, handle role, serialization, or support claim changed.

validation.buildResult: PASS: [100%] Built target dxfrw; [100%] Built target dwg2dxf.

focusedRegression.control: Generated AC1021 common OBJECT frames from scratch: a valid decoded prefix followed by 64 opaque body bits, then a complete following manager frame. The test checks Partial status, exact raw-frame retention, typedPayloadValidated=false, raw-only publication, and complete following-frame publication. No DWG/DXF fixture is added.

broaderSelector.result: PASS after S45. The first run exposed two test expectations that treated a softened record-level failure as a failed OBJECTS read, and one TABLECONTENT typed-callback leak for semantically incomplete content. S45 corrected the record-level expectations and guarded the TABLECONTENT callback; see docs/research/p5-tablecontent-semantic-incomplete-callback-guard-2026-11-18.json.

postChangeSampleRun.observation: The same 14 bounded bitlongs stop at bit 243 of the 205099-bit body limit. All 424 source frames publish with zero object/entity parse failures. Strict DXF output still refuses before publication on IMAGEDEF handle 0x7b owner-back-reference qualification, so this is not a PERSUBENTMGR output result.

disposition.P6B: OPEN; the manager tail, member semantics, producer/API operation, and selected path remain unqualified.
disposition.wholeFileOutput: S42's strict CLI attempt stopped before output on an unrelated IMAGEDEF owner-back-reference check at handle 0x7b; that blocker remains separate.
disposition.sourceCompatibility: Existing abbreviated AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 profiles retain their explicit Partial disposition; ordinary fully consumed bodies retain Complete.

next: Keep P6-B waiting for native API-state evidence and independent field/role proof. Do not generalize the source's flat-vector observations. Triage the three unrelated failures reported by the combined selector before using it as a readiness signal; the new focused regression selector is green. Continue unrelated ready profiles.
